note: Outside on almost every criterion, and unusually for this batch the rep saw it and acted on it. Occupation was never established beyond sitting all day, so there is no evidence of the business-owner or physician profile. Willingness to pay fails at $200 a month, let alone $6,000. Health is not neglected — he hikes six to ten miles every Sunday, swims, plays basketball weekly and attends a CrossFit gym, and he is under active medical care — it is disrupted by a gallbladder condition and its medication, which is a clinical problem rather than a neglect problem. And the goal is rescue, recovering forty-odd pounds gained since the illness, not good to great. The one criterion he satisfies is the exclusion: at 6'2" and 239 lb he is carrying weight, but he is the opposite of gym-averse. This is the batch's counterexample to the Martin call — a prospect outside the ICP whom the process correctly declined, and the reason it worked was a single question about medication side effects.
